utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I’m still in — I’ll be at the front porch Saturday to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Vik, thank you. I really appreciate you being there Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia. I’ll keep it simple: the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the updated details so we can get a couple more hands lined up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh — thanks, Rosa, but I had it set for Saturday on the front porch at 10 a.m. Could you keep it there so it stays simple?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren. I’ll send the start time and a quick rundown soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Tess. I’ll watch for the time and rundown, and I’ll be ready at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can come a little early and help set up at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Uli. Can you be there by 9:30 so we can get set up before 10?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there at 10 on Saturday to help at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Uli. See you at 10 on Saturday at the front porch!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll pass that along and keep rounding up a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess. I’ll keep the update moving and appreciate any extra hands for sorting and carrying on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, can you be at the front porch this Saturday at 10 a.m. for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I can be there at 10 a.m. on the front porch. A couple of helpers would make it much easier, so let’s keep it simple.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
